history.text: Settled for the offer pricing bug, all three together: add setup validation so a bad price can never be configured; keep a checkout safety backstop that rejects a bad price at purchase; and run a one-time cleanup that repairs the bad prices already saved.
Understood: setup validation, the checkout backstop and the cleanup of existing bad prices, all required.
Final plan: 1) saving a zero or negative price is rejected; 2) checkout rejects a zero or negative price. Both are implemented and tested. The offer pricing repair is fully covered and complete.
